title: An investigation of machine learning algorithms and data augmentation techniques for diabetes diagnosis using class imbalanced BRFSS dataset
pdf_fetch_attempts: 2026-07-01: DOI/ScienceDirect direct route first returned non-PDF HTML and was removed; Unpaywall found repository PDF at Texas Tech; downloaded source.pdf from https://ttu-ir.tdl.org/bitstreams/019c2bee-e086-4220-8066-0ef95d0887db/download; verified %PDF- and ~11 pages.
abstract: Investigates machine-learning algorithms and data augmentation techniques for diabetes diagnosis on a class-imbalanced BRFSS dataset; useful as a Layer 1 comparator for imbalance handling and oversampling/data-augmentation pipelines.
